title: Endur xSTRK + BTC LST vaults (Starknet) — no unprivileged value path
closed_reasons: All six ERC-4626 vaults share one class (0x5f06dcb8…); share math rounds in the vault's favour (1 STRK -> 0.841459 shares -> 0.999999999999999999 STRK, -1 wei)
vault.send_to_withdraw_queue / set_config / upgrade revert 'Caller does not have role' for an outsider
queue.request_withdrawal reverts 'Only LST can call' (claim-ticket mint gated to the LST)
queue.claim_withdrawal burns the NFT (no double claim) and reverts 'Too early to claim' before funding
queue.take_funds is ungated but only transferFrom's the caller's own STRK (net-neutral top-up)
total_assets (147.41M STRK) is fully backed by 147.49M staked STRK in the ValidatorRegistry
key_facts: xSTRK vault 0x028d709c875c0ceac3dce7065bec5328186dc89fe254527084d1689910954b0a; class 0x5f06dcb8ef65dd934ba261e6f5ddc03ad3707a028236289feef4ef451f01a52 (shared by all 6 vaults)
queue holds 551,214 STRK vs 107,926 STRK unprocessed (over-funded); 700-id sample found only 2 unclaimed
caveats: Contract classes are UNVERIFIED (no source on Voyager/Starkscan); logic inferred from ABI + live behaviour
queue.reduce_total_queue_amount signature unresolved; at worst a griefing surface, not extraction
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Endur: the vault's privileged paths are role-gated, the withdrawal-queue ticket mint is gated to the LST, share math rounds safely and total_assets is fully backed by staked STRK.
